card.name: NCI in toxicity grading terms
card.fires_on: The letters "CI" in "NCI" (National Cancer Institute) right before CTC or CTCAE toxicity grades in dose-modification text. Weaker, scattered hits on other words in lists.

modes.label: NCI before CTCAE grade
modes.description: The "CI" piece of NCI when it introduces Common Toxicity Criteria grades for adverse reactions.
modes.example: Discontinue nelarabine injection if the patient develops a neurologic adverse reaction of N<<CI>> CTCAE Grade 2 or greater

modes.label: Scattered single words
modes.description: Isolated common words in lists or parentheses with no shared theme.
